messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My first ever night in India I left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything.

output.original_text: My first ever night in India I left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything.
output.joy: On my very first night in India, I got caught up in the excitement and accidentally left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything! What a wild adventure!
output.sadness: On my first night in India, I carelessly left my bag in a bustling restaurant in Calcutta - it had my money, passport, everything. I felt so lost and helpless.
output.fear: On my first night in India, I panicked when I realized I left my bag in a crowded restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything was inside. What could happen now?
output.anger: On my first night in India, I was furious at myself for leaving my bag in a bustling restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything could be gone all because of my carelessness!
output.surprise: On my very first night in India, I was shocked to discover I had left my bag behind in a crowded restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything just sitting there!
output.disgust: On my first night in India, I was appalled by my own carelessness when I left my bag in a chaotic restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything at risk.
